plainTranslation:
This person may seem to read your mind.

You begin a thought and they are already inside it. You say something unfinished, uncertain, strange, and they do not ask you to defend it. They simply receive it. It can feel like a rare kind of permission. A reminder that not everything meaningful needs to be explained, justified, to be understood.

When this is working well, your imagination gets room to breathe. Thoughts arrive sideways. Through dreams. Through symbols. Through the song that won't leave your head. Through the memory that surfaces at exactly the right moment. They remind you that wisdom doesn't always arrive in a straight line. It may emerge quietly, before language can catch it. As an intuition. A subtle knowing. Something recognized inwardly long before it can be explained.

But the same wordless understanding can become a problem. Because so much is happening beneath the surface, very little may be spoken outright. You can start to believe that what feels true to you must also be true for them. Agreements are assumed instead of discussed. Expectations take shape without ever being named. Choices linger in the space between you, waiting for someone to claim them, while both of you trust that the other already knows. Later, confusion appears. You may feel certain an agreement was made, while they may feel no agreement ever existed. And both of you are telling your truth.

This aspect asks you to trust what you sense without treating it as certainty. Feelings carry truth, yet they do not always communicate the whole truth.
